name: sample-127-bug-application-for-hr-executive-role-unable
subject: Application for HR Executive Role – Unable to Apply via Website
latest_message:
Dear Flowmingo Team,

Greetings of the day,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to express my interest in the HR Executive position recently
posted on your website. However, I am currently facing an issue while
applying through the portal and am unable to submit my application online.

Therefore, I am sharing my application via email for your kind
consideration.

With 3 years of experience in the HR domain, I bring hands-on expertise in
Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and overall HR functions. I am confident
that my skills and experience align well with the requirements of this role.

Please find my resume attached for your review.

I would be grateful if you could consider my application and assist me
further with the process.

Thank you for your time and support. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best Regards,
Mehrishi Tiwari
Contact: 7999897828
